lines: This page contains transmissions done throughout the questline.

- Ordis: "So, this 'Limbo Theorem' you picked up, it's supposed to lead to a new Warframe? Well, it's woefully incomplete! Half-written proofs, unfinished equations, --what idiot wrote this mess??-- Okay. Okay. There is one thing here, a constant, a tuning frequency but it's so minute, the Orbiter's antenna would never be able to... unless... go to your nav console, I have an idea."
- Ordis: "These equations will continue to be a jumbo of nothing until we recover all the missing Proof Fragments and reforge this theorem."
- Ordis: "If you want to have any chance of recovering Limbo, you have to find those Proof Fragments to complete the theorem."
- Ordis: "If there are any proof fragments bouncing around this "Limbo frequency" these radio towers will pick it up."
- Ordis: (After capturing a tower) "A tower is online."
- Ordis: (After capturing a tower) "A tower has been captured. Scanning the Limbo frequency now."
- Ordis: (After capturing a tower) "We are now in control of this tower."
- Ordis: (After capturing all towers) "Operator, I am pleased to report we are in full control!"
- Ordis: (After capturing all towers) "We have established complete control."
- Ordis: (After losing a tower) "They took control of our tower --Make them pay!--"
- Ordis: (After losing a tower) "--No!-- They captured our tower."
- Ordis: (After losing a tower) "--We are losing control!--"
- Ordis: (Losing all towers) "--They are winning!-- May I suggest you capture a tower?"
- Ordis: (Losing all towers) "Operator, they have all four towers! --Stop them!--"
- Ordis: "Scan complete. Now we must clean up --Kill them all--"
- Ordis: "Excellent, we have completed the scan. May I suggest --turning every last enemy into scrap!--"
- Ordis: "We will attempt another scan of the frequency. I do hope you manage to pick something up."
- Ordis: "They're on to us now but if you would like, we can attempt another scan."
- Ordis: "The scan is complete. Did you find any Proof Fragments?"
- Ordis: "Scan completed. Were you able to recover any Proof Fragments?"
- Ordis: "Good, now we get to find out what all this Limbo nonsense is about. I await the theorem's completion."
- Ordis: "Okay, good, you've... wait... the horizon mass cannot be inverted to --this is preposterous!--"
- Ordis: "Operator, I'm sorry. You did all this work and this so called Theorem is still completely invalid. It's as if all these proofs point to nothingness, it's just --utterly irrational!--"
- Ordis: "There's only one valid coordinate in the entire proof. I've marked it on your navigation console but I'm sure it's a waste of time."

path: After Retrieving Limbo Neuroptics Blueprint from Cambria, Earth
lines: - Ordis: "A Limbo part blueprint! The Theorem wasn't complete malarkey after all. Perhaps there's more to these equations than I previously thought. What am I missing?"

- Ordis: "Operator, I found a new theorem hidden deep in that Warframe part. These are actually starting to make sense, I mean they're nonsense but there's logic in the nonsense. It's almost as if someone's trying to speak to me in my own language."

path: After Retrieving Limbo Neuroptics Blueprint from Cambria, Earth
lines: - Ordis: "Now it's becoming clear. Could it be that there's a plane between our normal plane and the void? A space between space, a rift? A rift that this Limbo could control?"
- Ordis: "Oh, and I've marked your navigation console. I think you'll be quite pleased with what you find there."

path: After Retrieving Limbo Systems Blueprint from Martialis, Mars
lines: - Ordis: "Operator do you understand, this Limbo is telling us his story in pure math, and I must say, he's quite witty."
- Ordis: "You have to forge that blueprint as soon as possible. I must know what comes next."

path: After Retrieving Limbo Systems Blueprint from Martialis, Mars
lines: - Ordis: "Just as I suspected, another theorem. Limbo's formula for inverting the entropic mass of void quantum is downright naughty."
- Ordis: "I want more. Operator, please hurry, this story is getting quite good."
- Ordis: "This Limbo is quite mischievious. Zipping in and out of the rift, sending whole armies into a purgatory of his whole making. Physics is wonderful!"

path: After Retrieving Limbo Systems Blueprint from Martialis, Mars
lines: - Ordis: "More parts to the story. My word, he is a magician of logic. Just when I think his diffraction principle is full of dangling ratios, he expresses his dynamic constant in pure numbers. I never saw it coming."

path: After Retrieving Limbo Chassis Blueprint from Ose, Europa
lines: - Ordis: "The final part. I cannot wait. What harrowing leaps of cross-dimensional gymnastics will he attempt next?"

path: After Retrieving Limbo Chassis Blueprint from Ose, Europa
lines: - Ordis: "Excellent, the final Theorem and its unfragmented. Processing."
- Ordis: "Oh. Wait, Limbo, no that's a mistake, you don't want to go there. It's too big a jump. You can't rift walk... ohh. Oh no."

- Ordis: "Operator, I think I know why we're finding Limbo parts scattered throughout the system. His final rift walk was a miscalc... --disaster.-- Well, perhaps when you occupy this frame, you will use more... caution."
- Ordis: "This new theorem is equally full of gaps, please, find more proof fragments."
- Ordis: "What is he trying to say? My apologies, Operator, I get a little worked up when it comes to physics."
- Ordis: "Please do find the rest of those proofs. I must solve these equations, the suspense is killing me."
